entry.description: Stop the file lock counter going negative. Writing the footer, closing the writer and opening the file released the lock even when acquiring it had failed, and a negative count made every later acquisition fail. The footer and close paths share one helper now, which releases only what it took; opening keeps its own acquire, because wrapping an unlocked stream throws. Nothing was lost by this, because the appender reopens the file on the next event (audit da18b6fd-f032, fixed by @FreeAndNil)
